strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Kurojishi, Blast Dragon, Houraiou die
Isn't the Gandor squad here yet!? Joe... hurry up and come.
Now that Princess Romina has gone up into space...
nothing stands in the way of defeating you...!
Ilbora! Just like you wanted, we got here ahead of the rest!
Going after a place like this with hardly any military facilities!
Don't you think that's dirty!?
Say what you like. I'll defeat you by any means necessary...
Every last one of you who took everything from me...!
You walked out on your own, so what are you talking about!?
That's the worst kind of misplaced grudge!
None of that matters anymore... I'll use any means I must...!
Even if it means borrowing the strength of people like them!
People like them...?
Tch, I don't care who you team up with! I won't go easy on you, Ilbora!
Hm... what's that? Those capsule-looking things all around.
Joe, don't tell me it's a trap...!
A trap!? Then we just smash it to bits!
Y-You're asking a lot... Big Bro...
I'll leave those capsule things to Lenny and Mike!
I'm taking down Ilbora!
Heh heh... Just what I wanted... Come at me!
(Can't wait any longer... Hazard said to blow them away, dragon and all...
but it can't be helped. At least I'll get Joe and the others.)
Fight me, Joe! We'll settle which of us is right!
Which of us is right!? How dare you even say that, Ilbora!
Heh... You always were good at barking, if nothing else.
Come... I'll prove right here that my choice was right in the end.
You've got some nerve...! Let's settle this, Ilbora!
Big Brooo!
Joe! I'm coming!
Heh heh heh, you fell for it...
Wh-What? What's going on?
Ilbora! What the hell did you do, you bastard!?
Fuhahaha...
Ngh, destroyed, was it... No matter. It was Hazard's half-baked idea...
It was never going to work...
We're not falling for your traps!
I dunno what you were plotting, but too bad for you, Ilbora!
...Don't get cocky, Joe! This isn't over yet!
What!?
M-Meganoids? This is bad, Big Bro...
What do we do, Joe... We're at a disadvantage...
Tch, hiding reinforcements? That's dirty, Ilbora!
Don't worry. I'll be your opponent.
Are you all right!? Lenny!
Yeah! More importantly, careful! Some weird device is set up here!
Master Banjo, isn't that...?
Yeah... it's the Teleport Machine the Meganoid Commanders used.
But why is it here?
A relic of the Commanders from the last war...
So you've finally come, Gandor.
By rights, I was to teleport you away along with everything...
but no matter. If I defeat you here, it's all the same...
As if it'd go that smoothly!
That Teleport Machine... It may be wise to destroy it, just in case.
True. If we leave it here, it's likely to cause trouble later...
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hmph... That man... After boasting he'd wipe the Gandor off the Earth...
Well, merely whittling down the enemy's forces is good enough.
At least it wasn't a wasted trip.
Oh? What's the matter, Ilbora? This isn't what you told us.
It's because the machines you lent me were too flimsy...
They were useless.
If you're going to squabble among yourselves, do it somewhere else.
Ngh, Banjo...
She's... a Megaborg!
The Meganoid that was dug in out in the desert the other day...!
Commander... Mylene, I believe she said?
That's right, old man.
The Mars development base governed by Commander Hazard
was originally a Meganoid base that was remodeled.
And word has it Commander Hazard is in league with the Za Boom army.
So what Joe said was true after all?
That right, Garrison, old man?
Indeed it is. And then there is the revival of the Meganoids.
Ilbora... was it?
If the Za Boom army is using Meganoid machines...
Yeah, Hazard Pasha is connected to the Za Boom army.
And to the Meganoids, too!
The reason we cooperate with that man Hazard is that Lord Don Zauser
is a man who honors his obligations.
Otherwise, we'd never deal with a man like that...
So Hazard thinks he's using them, but he's the one being used...
Besides, the reason we've joined hands with the Za Boom...
is that defeating the Gandor squad will let us speed up our plan
to turn all of humanity into Meganoids.
Heh, I bet they're thinking the same thing...
Ngh, for the sake of the Meganoids' tomorrow...
I shall wipe out every last human who stands in our way.
Let me tell you something, Commander Mylene...
As long as I'm around, the Meganoids have no tomorrow!
Hm! What's that!?
You're late, Tobikage!
Don't say that when it went to the trouble of coming!
Ngh... Withdraw!
Wait! You're not getting away!
No need to rush. We'll settle this eventually. Wait until then...
Unbelievable... With forces this meager, they got this far...!
A Megaborg's power only amounts to that much, after all.
We're a whole different class! Mars is next, so you'd better be ready!
Naturally. We're on a whole other level from you...!
I shall quietly withdraw for now.
But... the power of us Meganoids is far greater than this.
There you go again! Come anytime you like! Bleh!
Yeah, yeah. Nobody likes a woman who won't give up. Right, Hyoma?
Huh? Really? Isn't that a guy thing?
Or a guy who's clueless!
...You really are clueless, man.
(Can't wait any longer... Hazard said to blow them away, dragon and all...
but it can't be helped. At least I'll get Joe and the others.)
Fight me, Joe! We'll settle which of us is right!
Which of us is right!? How dare you even say that, Ilbora!
Heh... You always were good at barking, if nothing else.
Come... I'll prove right here that my choice was right in the end.
You've got some nerve...! Let's settle this, Ilbora!
Big Brooo!
Joe! I'm coming!
Heh heh heh, you fell for it...
Wh-What? What's going on?
Ilbora! What the hell did you do, you bastard!?
Fuhahaha...
What on earth was that light just now...?
What? A whole section of Kyoto has been scooped out!?
Hey, Banjo...! Could that be...?
Yeah... the Teleport Machine.
Teleport Machine?
That would be the Teleport Machine used in the last war by
the Meganoid Commander Duston.
It can teleport an entire area of land enclosed on three sides
to a different location.
What do we do!? Losing three units when we're stretched this thin...!
For now, let's take out the rest. Protecting the city comes first!
We're tracing the whereabouts of all three!
Like Lieutenant Amada said, there's no need to add to the city's damage.
Mop up the remaining forces!
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Commander Hazard and the Za Boom army... and the Meganoids, too.
With their base on Mars, there's nothing we can do right now...
That can wait, Commander Hazuki. Right now, all we can do is defend.
Not while the colony problem is still unsolved...
Hmm... I'll at least report it to Captain Bright.
Looks like we'll have to go all the way to Mars again someday...
Still, that bastard Ilbora... teaming up with the Meganoids...
Teleport Machine, was it? That machine?
Had that machine been activated,
the city of Kyoto would have been in dire straits indeed.
Good thing we destroyed it, anyway.
But could it really have teleported a whole town?
What do we do about Maya and the others?
With no communications getting through, there's nothing we can do.
Knowing them, I'd like to believe they'll manage somehow...
They'll be fine.
Amuro, Ryoma, and the others got blown away to Byston Well,
and they came back on their own, right? They'll be back eventually.
Right. No use overthinking it.
Sure is a lot of coming and going. ...Well, they'll be back eventually.
All we can do is wait, after all.
Is this how people saw it when we got sent to another world, too?
I guess it means they trust us... but it's kind of complicated.
Well, we made it back, after all.
